To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) employee likeability, posting frequency, and relative happiness are good predictors of turnover risk, (2) the ratio of likes received is a good proxy of likeability, (3) posting frequency is a good proxy for employee engagement and (4) relative happiness is the best proxy for employee happiness, (5) the ratio of happiness and likes is not a good proxy for either likeability or employee happiness.
“Employee likeability, engagement, and relative happiness are the most predictive features for predicting turnover risk.”
